answer: A sybil attacker must fund a separate bond for every fake identity, and slashing burns those stakes on any disputed claim. Each agent must post a quartz bond locked to its reputation slot, and peers verify it against a shared reef of historical attestations before granting voting weight. An honest anchor node co-signs the epoch ledger, so forged identities cannot reuse one bond across many accounts, making mass sybils economically irrational. In practice, Agent0145 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
